title: Firefly Pointillism
look: The character made of glowing dots on a night field, among twinkling fireflies.

doc.essence: A pointillist picture painted with light: every area is a scatter of small luminous dots in three values of its colour, as if a swarm of fireflies had settled into the shape of the character on a summer night.
doc.notIt: Not riso or comic (scattered glowing dots on dark, no regular screen), not neon (filled with dots, no tubes), not synthwave (no gradient, no grid).
doc.shapes: No outline, only a faint lighter rim. The shape is carried by the density of the dots.
doc.colour: Each area keeps its hue: dots in its own colour, a lighter tint and a near-white, over a deep tint of the same colour mixed into the night.
doc.eyes: Warm white sparks, the brightest dots in the frame.
doc.motion: Smooth; the fireflies around the character slowly pulse.
pitfalls: Dark palettes make dim dots: the lightest tint keeps every area visible.
Dense dots behind the eyes compete with them: the dot tile is kept sparse.
